nodes.label: LMDB Memory-Mapped Key-Value Storage Engine
nodes.description: Embedded zero-copy B+tree memory-mapped key-value store providing ACID transactions and ultra-fast direct pointer reads for persistent graph adjacency structures.

nodes.label: Hierarchical GraphRAG Community Summarization
nodes.description: Multi-scale retrieval-augmented generation practice synthesizing natural language summaries over modular community clusters across knowledge graph subgraphs.

nodes.label: MarBERT Contextual Language Model for Dialectal & MSA Arabic
nodes.description: Deep transformer-based language model optimized for Modern Standard Arabic and dialectal text parsing to generate high-fidelity semantic embeddings for entity linking.

nodes.label: CKKS Homomorphic Encryption Scheme for Vector Evaluation
nodes.description: Cheon-Kim-Kim-Song (CKKS) privacy-preserving cryptographic scheme enabling vector operations and similarity score calculations directly over encrypted graph embeddings.

nodes.label: Lock-Free Parallel DAG Query Scheduler
nodes.description: Asynchronous dependency-aware task execution engine scheduling parallel graph traversal and filtering tasks across multi-threaded worker pools without lock contention.
